torn_write_drill.note: Writes go to <file>.tmp, are fsynced, then os.replace()d. os.replace is atomic within a filesystem, so a real crash leaves either the whole old checkpoint or the whole new one. These corruptions are induced after the fact to prove the verifier would catch the case anyway.
